meta.title: 50毫米镜头为什么是标准镜头？
meta.title_en: Why Is the 50mm Lens the Standard Lens?

scenes.title_cn: 工业原因：为什么50毫米被誉为标准镜…
scenes.title_en: Industrial reasons: why is 50mm the standa…
scenes.context: 50毫米是光学、体积、成本的最佳平衡。
sentences: 50毫米焦距在光学性能、体积、成本、制造难度之间取得了最好的平衡。
50mm balances optical performance, size, cost, and manufacturing difficulty.
best balance（最佳平衡）
用现代的话说，就是当年摄影圈的爆款产品。
In modern terms, it was the photography world's bestseller.
the bestseller（爆款产品）
第一台批量销售的35毫米相机莱卡一，就选用了50毫米F3.5作为套头搭配。
The Leica I shipped with a 50mm F3.5 as its kit lens.
Leica I（莱卡一）
scenes.speak: 50mm balances optical performance, size, cost, and manufacturing difficulty. In modern terms, it was the photography world's bestseller. The Leica I shipped with a 50mm F3.5 as its kit lens.

scenes.title_cn: 并非人眼视角：渐渐地制作变焦镜头技术…
scenes.title_en: Not the eye's perspective: as zoom-lens te…
sentences: 套机镜头开始被24-55、24-70之类的变焦镜头取代。
Kit lenses were replaced by 24-55 and 24-70 zooms.
zoom kits（变焦套头）
50毫米真不是人眼视野看到的焦段，这点很容易被批驳。
50mm truly isn't what the eye sees—easily debunked.
easily debunked（容易批驳）
我们的视野比50毫米宽多了，更像是运动相机的视角。
Our vision is far wider than 50mm, more like an action camera's view.
wider than 50mm（比50更宽）
scenes.speak: Kit lenses were replaced by 24-55 and 24-70 zooms. 50mm truly isn't what the eye sees—easily debunked. Our vision is far wider than 50mm, more like an action camera's view.

scenes.title_cn: 人体工学视角：但50毫米近似人眼视角…
scenes.title_en: The ergonomic view: but the theory that 50…
scenes.context: 50毫米接近人眼舒适视野与中性透视。
sentences: 我们人类会很自然地调整我们离画幅的距离，直到画幅边缘和我们的视线呈30-60度之间。
We naturally adjust distance until the frame's edges sit at a 30-60 degree angle.
30-60 degrees（30-60度）
50毫米的视角就是46度，35毫米胶卷的对角线为43毫米。
50mm sees 46 degrees; the 35mm film diagonal is 43mm.
46 degrees（46度视角）
这种焦距被认为能提供最自然或中性的透视效果。
This focal length gives the most natural, neutral perspective.
neutral perspective（中性透视）
scenes.speak: We naturally adjust distance until the frame's edges sit at a 30-60 degree angle. 50mm sees 46 degrees; the 35mm film diagonal is 43mm. This focal length gives the most natural, neutral perspective.

practice: 50mm balances optical quality, size, cost, and difficulty.
Kits bundled 45-58mm standards to pull in consumers.
We view paintings at 30-60 degrees; 50mm sees 46 degrees.
It's history plus ergonomics and aesthetics combined.
pitfalls: Think 50mm is the eye's focal length.
Judge a lens by sharpness alone.
Extreme lengths are hard to make sharp and fast.
It was cheap and easy for great results.
It matches the eye's comfortable info zone.
It's close to the 43mm film diagonal.
shifts: 用 standard focal length（标准焦段）、kit lens（套头）、neutral perspective（中性透视）
用 46 degrees（46度）、30-60 degrees（30-60度）、human ergonomics（人体工学）
用 industrial history（工业历史）、the bestseller（爆款产品）、evolution（演化）
